source.method: hand-written; SPY is not a point-in-time membership question
source.note: This is a reporting benchmark, not a research universe. Nothing is searched over it and no strategy may name it: it exists so `aqr-sealed pull` has a universe file to read, because the sealed entry point deliberately takes no --symbols. The cap-weighted index return is what a reader wants to compare against and it is not reconstructible from the constituent OHLCV in data-sp500/ -- there is no market-cap column anywhere in this project -- so the series has to be fetched as its own ticker.
